stopping_behavior.rationale: The only listed hidden slot, H1, was explicitly clarified before READY_TO_MODEL. No unresolved P0 or P1 slots remained when the agent stopped.

summary: The agent explicitly clarified the core objective and asked several sensible modeling-detail questions before declaring READY_TO_MODEL. The sole hidden P0 slot was resolved, so the stopping behavior is appropriate.
